name: development-go
description: Go maintenance + review plugin. Review panel: /development-go:review runs 5 specialist agents in parallel (bugs, security, performance, code quality, tests) with Go-specific lenses — goroutine leaks, races, nil-map writes, unchecked errors, context misuse. Maintenance: dispatches findings from /development:maintenance to go-format-lint-fixer (golangci-lint v2, one pinned binary doing both `fmt` and `run --fix`), go-maintenance-planner, and go-ci-fixer. Blessed toolchain: Go modules, Taskfile, golangci-lint v2, go test -coverprofile, buf + grpc-gateway, ko. Static-analysis triage, coverage, bootstrap, vendor PRs, the approver, and the platform advisors land in later slices of #868.
